item: bro check agrees with a file the raw string guard kept
notes: Trial 66 (owner: a kept file is Not verified, in PR #325). Done there: RawStrings.KeepAsync reports a kept file as 'Not checked: <file>: the fix for IDE0055 would change the text of a raw string literal, so the file was left as it was', so bro format ends Not verified (exit 3). Open: bro check (verify) applies no fix, so nothing is kept and it says Clean (exit 0) on moq4's formatted tree, where the host's IDE0055 analysis no longer reports the file but the build's does (3 spots in src/Moq.CodeAnalysis.UnitTests/MockSetupGeneratorTests.cs, bro check --build says Not clean, exit 2). To do: make check say the same as format (from format's record when there is one, else by running the fixers on a copy for files with a raw string literal), or find why the host's and the build's IDE0055 differ for that file. Also find why Roslyn wants those edits (removing the project reference to Moq or IDE0055 made it stop; xunit, Nullable, ImplicitUsings, the TFM and LangVersion did not), and look for a small project that reproduces it (then a fixture). Done 2026-11-03: format records the kept files (#rawstring lines in the record of kept findings) and bro check, also from the fast record and with --json, says the same Not checked line and exits 3 (checked on moq4: format 3, check 3, check --build 2). Still open: why Roslyn wants those edits (no small reproduction, so no fixture), and why the host's IDE0055 analysis differs from the build's for that file after format.
